intro: For more than a decade I have recorded rainforests, rivers and volcanoes through Heart in Nature. Since 2015 my research has turned toward bioacoustics and neuroacoustics: how sound moves through the body and the nervous system. I turn those recordings into music, meditations and tools you can play.

research.title: Psychoacoustics
research.text: How the ear and brain turn vibration into feeling. The heart of my Master's in Sound Art.

research.title: Bioacoustics
research.text: Since 2015: the voices of living ecosystems, and how they shape our consciousness and nervous system.

research.title: 3D sound
research.text: Binaural and ambisonic environments for installations, planetariums and headphones.
